consequence.statement: Clustermesh-apiserver pods will run with restricted security contexts (dropped capabilities, non-root user) by default if the operator does not explicitly override these values.

original.statement: The clustermesh-apiserver's Helm chart values for `podSecurityContext` and `securityContext` now default to dropping all capabilities and running as a non-root user.

decision.reason: [ev-da6e6a1ea917] says only that the clustermesh-apiserver podSecurityContext and securityContext settings now default to dropping all capabilities and running as a non-root user. It does not say that anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured. A changed default that still works is behavior-change, which needs review. The proposed statement says the same thing as the evidence and does not claim mandatory work.
